samples.summary: The frontend's duplicated CRDT read boundary gets all five new bands but no test at all
samples.evidence: The diff adds normalizeFontSize / isPaintableImageSize / normalizeCellPadding / normalizeRowHeight / normalizeListLevel to `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts` (parseInlineStyle ~192, image ~209, parseCellStyle ~316, rowHeights ~466, listLevel ~512). New tests only exercise the *engine* copy (`packages/docs/test/model/numeric-attrs.test.ts`, `row-height.test.ts`, `list-level.test.ts` — all through `src/model/crdt-tree.ts#treeNodeToBlock`). I grepped `packages/frontend` for every new symbol: the only hit is the source file itself; `packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.test.ts` mentions `fontSize`/`listLevel`/`padding` only with in-band values, and its existing poisoned-attribute tests ('should read a legacy poisoned style as the block defaults', lines 2637-2672, 'poisoned header marginFromEdge') cover only the shared `parseBlockStyleAttrs` path, not the five new inline bands. This is the copy the live collaborative editor actually reads through — the hostile-peer hang/OOM scenario the whole change is justified by — and the frontend package has no `tsc` lane either, so a typo'd or inverted band there ships silently. Every new pagination test (`test/model/row-height.test.ts` paginateWith, `test/model/numeric-attrs.test.ts` paginateCellWith) uses `DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP` only; I grepped `packages/docs/test/view/pagination.test.ts` for `margins`/`pageSetup`/`contentHeight` and found no oversized-margin/zero-content-height case. samples.summary: Pagination poison assertions are upper-bound only, and the NaN / negative cases pass without the change
samples.evidence: `expect(result.pages.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(202)` (numeric-attrs.test.ts, three tests) and `toBeLessThanOrEqual(16)` (row-height.test.ts 'paginateLayout terminates on an unbounded row height') only bound from above. For the `NaN` and `-1e9` poison values the pre-change code already produced one page (`currentY + NaN <= contentHeight` is false, and `while (consumed < NaN)` never iterates), so those loop iterations assert nothing about the new `paginatableRowHeight`. Nothing pins the clipped span from below either, so a regression making `paginatableRowHeight` return 0 for *all* heights would only be caught by the single 'a genuinely tall cell still splits across pages' control (>= 2 pages), not by these tests. Adding a lower bound for the 1e9 cases (e.g. > 50 pages) would make them able to fail for the right reason.

samples.summary: text-box-editor's new doc.batch() around indent/outdent (one undo unit) is untested
samples.evidence: `initializeTextBox`'s `indent`/`outdent` now wrap `applyListLevelChanges` in `doc.batch()` specifically so the N `setBlockType` writes are one undo unit. The only new text-box test ('indent / outdent carry a list item’s nested children', test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts) asserts the final committed levels `[1, 2]` — which, as the docs-side lessons note records for MemDocStore, is unchanged whether or not the batch exists. The docs editor got a purpose-built `TracingStore` recording batch depth plus `canUndo() === false`; the text-box path (what Slides and Board mount) has no equivalent, so removing its batch would not fail any test.

finding.summary: The frontend's duplicated CRDT read boundary gets all five new bands but no test at all
finding.evidence: The diff adds normalizeFontSize / isPaintableImageSize / normalizeCellPadding / normalizeRowHeight / normalizeListLevel to `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts` (parseInlineStyle ~192, image ~209, parseCellStyle ~316, rowHeights ~466, listLevel ~512). New tests only exercise the *engine* copy (`packages/docs/test/model/numeric-attrs.test.ts`, `row-height.test.ts`, `list-level.test.ts` — all through `src/model/crdt-tree.ts#treeNodeToBlock`). I grepped `packages/frontend` for every new symbol: the only hit is the source file itself; `packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.test.ts` mentions `fontSize`/`listLevel`/`padding` only with in-band values, and its existing poisoned-attribute tests ('should read a legacy poisoned style as the block defaults', lines 2637-2672, 'poisoned header marginFromEdge') cover only the shared `parseBlockStyleAttrs` path, not the five new inline bands. This is the copy the live collaborative editor actually reads through — the hostile-peer hang/OOM scenario the whole change is justified by — and the frontend package has no `tsc` lane either, so a typo'd or inverted band there ships silently. Precedent for the missing test exists two lines away in the same file (the `textIndent: 'Infinity'` fixture at 2654).

verdict.reason: The five new band call sites do exist in the frontend read boundary (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:200 normalizeFontSize, :217 isPaintableImageSize, :323 normalizeCellPadding, :474 normalizeRowHeight, :520 normalizeListLevel), and I found no test that drives any of them with an out-of-band value. All new band tests go through the engine copy: packages/docs/test/model/numeric-attrs.test.ts:77-142 builds fixtures via treeNodeToBlock (src/model/crdt-tree.ts), likewise row-height.test.ts and list-level.test.ts. I chased the non-obvious candidates and they do not cover it: packages/docs/test/store/entry-parity.test.ts:49-51 names list-level.js/row-height.js/numeric-attrs.js but only asserts that src/index.ts and src/node.ts re-export the same identifiers (it reads entry-file text, never the frontend store, never a value); packages/docs/test/model/crdt-attrs.test.ts mentions YorkieDocStore only in its header comment and tests the authoredMargin*/authoredLineHeight marker codec; no test reads the frontend source as a parity fixture (readFileSync in packages/frontend/tests appears only in visual/google-font-cache.test.ts). The frontend's own poisoned-attribute tests (tests/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.test.ts:2637-2672 and :2677-2699) poison lineHeight/marginTop/marginBottom/textIndent/marginFromEdge, which all traverse the shared parseBlockStyleAttrs path, and the finiteness sweep at :2669-2671 iterates only blocks[0].style, which never holds inline fontSize, listLevel, rowHeights, or cell padding. Repo-wide, every 1e9/Infinity/NaN poison literal in a test file lives under packages/docs/test/model/; frontend fontSize fixtures are 14/18/20 and listLevel is 0/1, and the concurrent integration suite uses rowHeights [40, undefined]/[30, 50]. One nuance against the finding's framing: the normalizers are imported from @wafflebase/docs (lines 50-55), not duplicated, so the band arithmetic is covered; what is untested is the frontend-specific wiring in its own parseInlineStyle/treeNodeToBlock/parseCellStyle (:186-230, :460-522). That narrows the residual risk but does not refute the claim, and under the test-adequacy rubric an untested new guard on the live collaborative read path — where an omitted or inverted call reopens the hang/OOM the change exists to close — is a major missing-test gap.
